personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe elevated surfaces (Fusion)
personality_one_liner: A sophisticated, premium fintech experience driven by warm sunset gradients, architectural typography, and deep ink accents.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable layout. Let the data breathe. Use xl and 2xl for major sections.

do's: Featured dashboard hero cards layered over the mesh background
Blur overlay on the AI Insights 'Pro' gate

screens.name: OnboardingAuth
screens.purpose: Introduce the app and login/signup via JWT.
screens.layout: Full-bleed 'hero_mesh' background. A glassmorphic bottom sheet houses the email/password form. Use architectural display typography for the welcoming title.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of total monthly spend, categories, and upcoming renewals.
screens.layout: Hero summary card at the top using the 'hero_mesh' background with a transparent-to-surface gradient scrim (ensuring text contrast), featuring an animated counter for total spend. Below, a category breakdown chart utilizing teal, coral, and gold accents. Followed by a horizontal scrolling list of 'Upcoming Renewals' using frosted glass cards.

screens.name: SubscriptionsList
screens.purpose: Comprehensive, sortable list of all tracked subscriptions.
screens.layout: Vertical list. Each row prominently displays the brand logo (via clearbit URL), name, cost, billing cycle badge, and next renewal date. Grouped by category. Implement staggered entrance animations for rows using Reanimated.

screens.name: AddEditSubscription
screens.layout: Presented as a modal or bottom sheet. Features a single-column layout. The amount input is large at the top. Includes a toggle for monthly/yearly/weekly. The primary 'Save' CTA is sticky at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: SubscriptionDetail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific subscription's history and management.
screens.layout: A top hero section tinted with the specific brand's primary color (or a gradient mesh), displaying the logo and name. Below is a timeline view of past payments. A sticky bottom glass bar houses 'Pause' and 'Cancel' actions.

screens.name: AI_Insights
screens.purpose: Freemium spending analysis gated behind a 'Pro' upgrade.
screens.layout: The top half shows accessible basic insights. The bottom half is overlaid with a heavy `expo-blur` (glassmorphism), obscuring advanced 'Unused Subscription Alerts'. A prominent glowing 'Upgrade to Pro' CTA sits centered over the blur.

screens.name: CalendarTimeline
screens.layout: Vertical timeline layout with tracking dots and connecting lines. Each node represents a due payment day, displaying the brand logo and amount. Today's date is clearly highlighted.

screens.name: ProfileSettings
screens.layout: Clean list layout with tinted icon containers for each setting row (e.g., Security, Notifications, Logout). Settings rows should have chevron indicators.

hero_mesh.alt: Soft warm peach and coral abstract gradient mesh texture

premium_bg.alt: Abstract premium gold and teal geometric background

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL RULE: DO NOT use purple, violet, or indigo. Stick entirely to the provided warm Peach/Ink/Coral/Teal palette to avoid AI slop aesthetics.

FONTS (CRITICAL): Do not use @expo-google-fonts. Execute a bash tool call to download the fonts: `mkdir -p assets/fonts && wget -qO assets/fonts/CabinetGrotesk-Medium.otf 'https://github.com/morteza-f/Cabinet-Grotesk/raw/main/fonts/CabinetGrotesk-Medium.otf' && wget -qO assets/fonts/CabinetGrotesk-Bold.otf 'https://github.com/morteza-f/Cabinet-Grotesk/raw/main/fonts/CabinetGrotesk-Bold.otf' && wget -qO assets/fonts/Satoshi-Medium.otf 'https://github.com/morteza-f/Satoshi/raw/main/fonts/Satoshi-Medium.otf' && wget -qO assets/fonts/Satoshi-Bold.otf 'https://github.com/morteza-f/Satoshi/raw/main/fonts/Satoshi-Bold.otf'`

In your code, load these fonts using expo-font: `Font.loadAsync({ CabinetGrotesk: require('./assets/fonts/CabinetGrotesk-Medium.otf'), Satoshi: require('./assets/fonts/Satoshi-Medium.otf'), ... })` and apply them correctly via a custom Text component or StyleSheet.

MOCK DATA: Populate the initial app state with rich curated subscriptions (e.g., Netflix, Spotify, Amazon Prime) using their real brand colors and logo URLs (use `https://logo.clearbit.com/netflix.com`, `https://logo.clearbit.com/spotify.com`, etc.) for their card avatars.
ANIMATIONS: Use `react-native-reanimated` to build an animated counter for the Dashboard's total spend, staggered entry animations for the Subscription List rows, and fluid transitions.

AI INSIGHTS: Construct a freemium 'Insights' screen. Show basic insights at the top. Use `expo-blur` to heavily blur out the advanced savings suggestions, placing a premium 'Upgrade to Pro' CTA button in the center of the blurred region.

UI COMPOSITION: Use a premium Glass/Luxe approach. Ensure text over images has a gradient scrim behind it. On the dashboard hero card, use the 'hero_mesh' background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceSecondary) to ensure the Ink-colored text remains strictly readable.
JWT AUTH: Implement a simple JWT-based auth flow using email and password, styled cleanly over the mesh background.
